Integration service
body.Description: Technical: the identity of the portal and app integrations. Not a person.

Microbiology reviewer
body.Description: Reviews the Microbiology sections, asks the supplier directly and completes the Microbiology review.

body.Description: Reviews the QM sections, asks the supplier directly and completes the QM review.

body.Name: Raw Material Manager (RMM)
body.Description: Owns CIQ cases: starts them, sets target markets, watches bottlenecks, escalates, cancels or closes.
